Yash's Film 'Toxic' Box Office Performance Declines

Yash's film 'Toxic' experienced a further decline in its box office collection on its ninth day, earning approximately ₹4.25 crore net in India. This represents a 22% drop from the previous day's collection of ₹5.45 crore. The film has accumulated an estimated ₹328.45 crore worldwide against a reported production budget of around ₹500 crore. Meanwhile, the small-budget film 'Hanuman Ansh' has gained screens and is preparing for a global release, reportedly outperforming 'Toxic' in some metrics. 'Toxic' is also set to be released with a shorter cut.
